description: Apparatus for preparing ethyne and collecting it over water: a dropping funnel with a tap fitted into a conical flask that holds solid lumps; a delivery tube from the flask's side arm runs into a trough of water, where bubbles rise into an inverted test tube filled with water.

Skeletal structure of hydroxyhydroquinone as printed on the right of the question: a benzene ring with an OH group on each of the two top carbon atoms (labelled HO and OH) and a third OH group on the lower right carbon atom.
The three oil-refining processes the question refers to, labelled A, B and C: A, C6H14 → X + 4H2; B, C18H38 → C6H14 + C4H8 + C2H4 + 2Y; C, C5H12 → C5H12.
Reaction scheme drawn as boxes and arrows: C2H5OH is converted to C2H4 by conversion W; C2H4 is converted to C2H6 by H2 and, by reaction X, to polymer P; C2H6 is converted to C2H5Cl by reaction Y.
Data table for the decomposition of NO2: time (s) 0, 50, 100, 300, 400 and 600 against concentration of NO2 (mol L−1) 0.010, 0.0079, 0.0065, 0.0038, 0.0034 and 0.0030.
Diagram for the oxidation of methanol with a platinum wire catalyst: a conical flask with a coiled wire hanging down into it from a grey bar laid across its mouth.
Reaction scheme: a box labelled alcohol X with an arrow labelled A pointing to a box labelled propanone.
Table with the columns acid, initial concentration and pH at 25 °C: HCl, 0.1 M, 1.0; CH3COOH, 0.1 M, 2.8.

Diagram of the electrolytic cell for extracting aluminium: three block electrodes hanging from a bar labelled anode dip into a shaded layer labelled electrolyte; the tank lining is labelled cathode, and a spout at the lower right carries off a layer labelled aluminium.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Q7(b)(iv), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: the Kc expression set as a fraction, [CO][H2]3 over [CH4][H2O], beside the note [award 3 marks if round brackets are used] and the mark [6].

The marking scheme's own working for 2026 HL Q7(b)(v), as printed: convert to moles per litre (÷4) [3]; i.e. 0.8 over 4 = 0.2 (mol L−1 of CH4), 3.6 over 4 = 0.9 (mol L−1 of H2O), 6.8 over 4 = 1.7 (mol L−1 CO), 20.4 over 4 = 5.1 (mol L−1 H2); Kc = [1.7][5.1]3 over [0.2][0.9] = 1252.8 (mol2 L−2) [3].

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Q4(c), as the State Examinations Commission printed it: the nuclear equation carbon-14 (mass number 14, atomic number 6) gives nitrogen-14 (mass number 14, atomic number 7) plus an electron written with mass number 0 and charge −1, or a beta particle written the same way.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Q4(k), as printed: the full structural formula of methyl ethanoate, CH3–C(=O)–O–CH3, with every atom and bond drawn, the carbonyl oxygen double-bonded above the second carbon.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Q5(b)(iii), as printed: a dot and cross diagram of AsH3 with three H atoms each sharing a dot and a cross with As and a lone pair of two crosses on As, above the note [maximum 3 marks if lone pair is omitted from As].

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Q6(b)(iv), as printed: the three isomers of C5H12 drawn with all atoms and bonds, separated by //: the straight chain of five carbons, a four-carbon chain with a CH3 branch on the second carbon, and a three-carbon chain with two CH3 branches on the middle carbon.

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Q8(b)(i), as printed: two repeating units of poly(ethene), a chain of four carbon atoms each bonded to two hydrogen atoms above and below, with open bonds at both ends, beside the note [allow 3 marks for omission of C– at ends].

The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Q11(a)(iv), as printed: the full structure of propan-2-ol with all atoms and bonds, the O–H bond and the C–H bond on the central carbon each circled in red as the bonds broken.
The marking scheme's own answer to 2026 HL Q11(a)(v), as printed: the full structure of propanone with all atoms and bonds, the second bond of the C=O double bond circled in red as the bond formed.
